programs.title: Be Careful What You Say
programs.desc: Podcast host Iris Atwood gives Vanessa, a single mother, advice on how to raise her out-of-control son. However, when the teen ends up tragically dying, Vanessa blames Iris and returns six months later to seek revenge.

programs.title: Mother's Deadly Son
programs.desc: Marianne is in a desperate fight for the survival of her only son and must fight for his life to prove his innocence.

programs.title: Who's Stalking My Family
programs.desc: A woman discovers that someone wants her dead after her teenage daughter starts tutoring a new student.

programs.title: Dateless to Dangerous: My Son's Secret Life
programs.desc: A teen becomes angry, isolated and hostile when he's rejected by a few girls at school. When he joins a shadowy online underworld that fuels his growing resentment, his mother and sister race against time to try and save him.

programs.title: My Son Didn't Do It
programs.desc: Doing her best to balance a successful career with family life, a single mother's world spirals out of control when her shy teenage son is arrested for the murder of a young woman he met online.

programs.title: Have You Seen My Son?
programs.desc: Released from prison, a woman tries to find out where her child vanished to while she was away. When her journey leads her down a winding path that puts her life in danger, she realizes that learning the truth might come at the cost of her freedom.
